pages.name: Activity feed
pages.description: A React Native activity feed for iOS, Android and the web: who did what and when, grouped by day, relative times, filter chips, unread dots with Mark all as read, quoted comments, Load more, and tappable names. Accessible, animated, themeable.

pages.name: Agenda
pages.description: A React Native agenda for iOS, Android and the web: the days ahead as a list under a week strip with event dots, all-day events first, start times and durations, a now line, sticky day headings and empty days. Accessible and themeable.

pages.name: Agent activity
pages.description: A React Native AI agent activity view for iOS, Android and the web: each step an agent takes (thinking, searching, tools, code, files) with spinners, durations, inputs, outputs and sources, nested steps, approvals, Stop and Try again, and a one-line summary.

pages.name: AI usage meter
pages.tags: AI Usage Meter, tokens and credits (Pro)
pages.description: A React Native AI usage meter for iOS, Android and the web: tokens, credits or spend against the plan's limit, split by model, with the reset date, a forecast at the current pace, warning and over-limit states and Upgrade. Bar, ring, gauge, card and compact.

pages.name: Event calendar
pages.tags: Event Calendar, month week and day views (Pro)
pages.description: A React Native event calendar for iOS, Android and the web: month, week and day views, overlapping events side by side, all-day events, a now line, +N more, period navigation, and press an empty time to add an event. Accessible, animated, zero native code.

pages.name: Gantt
pages.description: A React Native Gantt chart for iOS, Android and the web: task bars with progress, milestones, dependency arrows, weekends and a today line, day, week and month scales, and drag to move or stretch tasks, with keyboard and screen-reader alternatives.

pages.name: Kanban
pages.tags: Kanban Board with drag and drop (Pro)
pages.description: A React Native kanban board for iOS, Android and the web: drag cards between columns with the mouse or a finger, auto-scroll, WIP limits, tags, due dates, priority and assignees, plus an accessible Move to menu, screen-reader actions and keyboard moves. Zero native code.

pages.name: Order tracker
pages.description: A React Native order tracker for iOS, Android and the web: the arrival day, status badge, a progress bar or step line to the step reached, delayed and failed states, carrier and copyable tracking number, and the carrier's scan history. Accessible and animated.

pages.name: Blocks
pages.description: Ready React Native blocks for iOS, Android and the web: kanban board with drag and drop, event calendar, agenda, Gantt chart, timeline, wizard, stats row, pricing table, product card, review list, order tracker, activity feed, AI agent activity and AI usage meter. Accessible, animated, themeable, zero native code.

pages.name: Pricing table
pages.description: A React Native pricing table for iOS, Android and the web: plan cards with a Most popular highlight, a Monthly / Yearly toggle with the saving worked out, per-month prices, a feature comparison table, and a phone paywall list with radios. Accessible and animated.

pages.name: Product card
pages.description: A React Native product card for iOS, Android and the web: photo with sale and stock badges, wishlist heart, rating, struck-through sale price, color swatches that swap the photo, and Add to cart that turns into a quantity stepper. Vertical, horizontal, compact and overlay.

pages.name: Review list
pages.description: A React Native review list for iOS, Android and the web: the average rating, count and star distribution bars that filter, sorting, verified buyers, photos, seller replies, Read more, Helpful votes and paging. Accessible, animated and themeable.

pages.name: Stats row
pages.description: A React Native stats row for iOS, Android and the web: dashboard KPI tiles with the change in words, arrows and color, sparkline trends, currency and percent formats, wrapping or scrolling, and selectable tiles that switch a chart. Accessible and themeable.

pages.name: Timeline
pages.description: A React Native timeline for iOS, Android and the web: events along a line with status markers (done, in progress, upcoming, failed), icons, times on either side, alternating sides, cards, day headings, Show more, and a horizontal mode. Accessible, animated, themeable.

pages.name: Wizard
pages.description: A React Native wizard for iOS, Android and the web: a multi-step form with numbered steps, a progress bar, dots or a side list, sync and async validation with messages, optional steps with Skip, slide transitions, and an async finish. Accessible and themeable.

pages.name: AI Chat
pages.description: A complete React Native AI chat for iOS, Android and the web: streaming Markdown replies token by token, reasoning, tool calls, stop and retry, older history on scroll-up, quick replies, attachments and a keyboard-aware composer. Works with any backend: fetch streams, server-sent events or your own state. Replaces react-native-gifted-chat.

pages.name: Bar chart
pages.description: A React Native bar chart for iOS, Android and the web: grouped, stacked, 100% stacked and horizontal bars, goal marks, value labels, reference lines, negative values, bars that grow into new data, legend toggles, currency and percent axes, loading and empty states, RTL and screen-reader summaries.

pages.name: Brand icons
pages.description: 147 brand and social logos for React Native, Expo and the web: X, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, GitHub, Google, Apple, Stripe, PayPal, Spotify, Discord, AI brands and more. In brand color, one color or as app-icon tiles, dark-mode aware, typed by name and tree-shakeable. Part of Patine Pro.

pages.name: Charts
pages.description: Accessible, animated React Native charts for iOS, Android and the web: line, area, bar, combo, pie, donut, radial, gauge, calendar heatmap, scatter, bubble, funnel, radar, sparkline and status tracker. Live data that glides, stacked and 100% layouts, reference lines, goals, legend toggles, scrubbing with haptic-ready callbacks, loading and empty states, RTL, dark mode and screen-reader summaries. Built on react-native-svg.

pages.name: Combo chart
pages.description: A React Native combo chart for iOS, Android and the web: bars and lines or areas over the same categories, a second value axis on the right, stacked bars, dashed targets, tooltips for every series, legend toggles, animated data and screen-reader summaries.

pages.name: Funnel chart
pages.description: A React Native funnel chart for iOS, Android and the web: conversion stages as centred bars with connectors, each stage's count and its share of the first or the previous step, animated data, tooltips by touch, pointer or keyboard, and a screen-reader summary of each drop-off.

pages.name: Gauge
pages.description: A React Native gauge for iOS, Android and the web: one value on a speedometer arc with colored ranges, a target mark, a filled arc or a needle that sweeps to each new value, and a screen-reader summary of the value, its share and its range.

pages.name: Calendar heatmap
pages.description: A React Native calendar heatmap for iOS, Android and the web: days as shaded squares a week per column, like GitHub contributions, with month and weekday labels, a Less–More scale, tooltips by touch, pointer or keyboard, and a screen-reader summary of the total and the busiest day.

pages.name: Icons
pages.description: Patine Icons: 669 original SVG icons for React Native, Expo and the web, in outline, solid, duotone and color, across 27 categories from status and states to text editing, layout, development, food, sports and accessibility. Drawn on a 24-point grid with a 1.5 stroke, typed by name, mirrored in right-to-left layouts, decorative or labelled for screen readers, and tree-shakeable one module per icon. Part of Patine Pro, built on react-native-svg.

pages.name: Line & Area chart
pages.description: React Native line and area charts for iOS, Android and the web: live data that glides to new values, stacked and 100% areas, gradient fills, step and monotone curves, dashed forecasts, reference lines and bands, currency and percent axes, legend toggles, scrubbing with haptic-ready callbacks, loading and empty states, RTL and screen-reader trend summaries.

pages.name: Pie & Donut chart
pages.description: React Native pie and donut charts for iOS, Android and the web: slices that sweep in and turn to new shares, half donuts, outside percent labels, the slice under the finger in the donut's hole, legend toggles that leave a slice out, and a screen-reader summary of each part's share.

pages.name: Radar chart
pages.description: A React Native radar (spider) chart for iOS, Android and the web: several measures on spokes, one filled outline per series, polygon or circle rings, outlines that reshape to new data, legend toggles, tooltips per spoke and a screen-reader summary of each series' strongest and weakest measure.

pages.name: Radial chart
pages.description: A React Native radial chart for iOS, Android and the web: concentric rings that fill toward each goal and glide to new values, like Apple's activity rings, with a track, the first ring's share in the middle, tooltips by touch, pointer or keyboard, loading states and a screen-reader summary.

pages.name: Scatter & Bubble chart
pages.description: React Native scatter and bubble charts for iOS, Android and the web: points by group with their own color and shape, area-true bubbles, a line of best fit, date or number x axes, tooltips for the nearest point, legend toggles, animated data, and a screen-reader summary with the correlation.

pages.name: Sparkline
pages.description: A small React Native sparkline for iOS, Android and the web: a trend line, a gradient area or spark bars with no axes beside a number, gliding to live values, with a screen-reader summary of its range and trend.

pages.name: Status tracker
pages.description: A React Native status tracker for iOS, Android and the web: a row of bars coloured by status, as uptime pages show service health, with each period's details by touch, pointer or keyboard, and a screen-reader count of each status.

pages.name: TreeView
pages.description: A virtualized React Native tree view for iOS, Android and the web: expand and collapse with any icon, single selection or checkboxes with indeterminate parents, children loaded on demand, indent guides, WAI-ARIA keyboard navigation on the web and a design per platform. Part of Patine Pro, React Native core only.

pages.name: Budgeting: Penny
pages.description: A complete React Native personal budgeting app for iOS, Android and the web: what is safe to spend today, activity by day with swipe to split, budgets you drag to reorder and resize, insights, savings goals, bills and subscriptions, and quick cash expenses.

pages.name: Crypto wallet: Orbit
pages.description: A complete React Native crypto wallet for iOS, Android and the web: a portfolio you can scrub through, markets with a sortable table, coin detail, swaps that show every fee and the price impact, receiving by QR code, activity and account security.

pages.name: Fitness: Stride
pages.description: A complete React Native fitness and health app for iOS, Android and the web: setup in three steps, activity rings, programs and workouts, a live workout with a timer and heart-rate zones, progress charts, a class timetable on an event calendar, badges and a leaderboard.

pages.name: Food delivery: Basil
pages.description: A complete React Native food delivery app for iOS, Android and the web: offers and restaurants near you, a menu by section, a dish to customise, a basket with tips and deals, live order tracking, a chat with the courier, and rating the order.

pages.name: App layout
pages.tags: Responsive app layout for React Native (Pro)
pages.description: AppShell, Page, Panel, DataTable, StatCard, QueryState, CommandPalette and AuthShell: the responsive layout behind Patine Pro's apps. One React Native codebase becomes a tab bar on phones, a navigation rail on tablets and a sidebar on desktop and the web.

pages.name: Product analytics: Signal
pages.description: A complete React Native analytics workspace for iOS, Android and the web: KPIs and traffic, a sign-up funnel, audience segments, saved reports with a tree and pagination, a roadmap Gantt, a sprint Kanban, an AI copilot that shows its queries, status and billing.

pages.name: Boutique store: Ouro
pages.description: A complete React Native boutique store for iOS, Android and the web: an editorial front page with a carousel, search and sort, product pages with swatches, gallery and reviews, a bag with swipe actions and promo codes, a four-step checkout, order tracking, saved items and the account.

pages.name: Travel: Wander
pages.description: A complete React Native travel app for iOS, Android and the web: places to explore, weather by month, flight results by price and day, booking with a seat map, a boarding pass with a QR code, an itinerary, an AI trip planner and shared expenses.
